newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gradall aggressive buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gradall aggressive buy.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said it initiated coverage of Gradall Industries Inc at aggressive buy. The stock was at 11, up 1/4.
The Ohio-based maker of excavators and materials handling equipment had its initial public offering in August at $10 a share.

Analyst Michael Linsky said in a report he estimated the company, which earned $0.77 in 1995, will earn $1.06 this year and $1.35 in 1997 and could post double-digit earnings-per-share growth in 1998.
"Our 12-18 month price target for the sharers, which we view as highly attractive, is $16-17," he said.
